summary: Iteration 2 — Spanish default + lateral side menu + language-based URLs. Backend regression suite (10/10) re-passed against existing /api/contact-requests endpoint. Frontend: all 23 requested behaviours verified via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL after clearing localStorage. Root / redirects to /es, document.documentElement.lang === 'es', hero shows 'Viajes a Medida', side menu renders the 7 Spanish top-level items with correct data-testids, tours→catalog→leaves expand to 7 entries, about-cluster expands to 4 leaves, menu-link-south navigates to /es/viajes/sur-de-marruecos and the StubPage hero shows the Spanish overline 'Sur de Marruecos' plus ContactForm. Language switching while on the Sur stub round-trips ES↔EN↔FR with matching localized URLs (sur-de-marruecos ↔ southern-morocco ↔ sud-du-maroc) and translated copy. Direct visits to /en/tours/short-escapes, /fr (French home), /es/cita-previa all render the correct page. Unknown slug /es/random-thing redirects to /es home with no crash. Side-menu close button hides the drawer (aria-hidden becomes true). Hero CTA 'Planificar mi viaje' scrolls #contact into view. Footer enquire button is lang-correct on /es (/es/contacto), /en (/en/contact), /fr (/fr/contact). localStorage key 'xaluca-tours-lang' is updated when language changes. Zero console errors on default home load.

issues: The floating language switcher (z-30, bottom-left) is fully covered by the side-menu drawer (z-60) when the drawer is open. Users can only switch language with the menu closed. Either lift the switcher above z-60, mirror language buttons inside the side menu, or hide the switcher while open to avoid the dead click area.

action_items: Optional UX: language switcher is occluded by the open side menu — consider rendering language buttons inside the SideMenu drawer or raising z-index.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.js resolvePath: routeId match is O(routes * langs) per lookup — acceptable for current size but could be precomputed into a slug→{routeId,lang} reverse map.

LanguageContext setLang(): the URL is rewritten via navigate(nextPath) and state is set in parallel. The URL effect already syncs state back, so the explicit setLangState in setLang is redundant (minor — no functional issue observed).
App.js: building `allPaths` for every (lang, routeId) and registering each as an explicit Route is fine, but the trailing `path="/:lang/*"` catch-all alone would be sufficient and reduce route count.
SideMenu line 25 closes drawer on every location.pathname change including the initial / → /es redirect. Harmless since menu starts closed, but worth a guard if you ever default-open it.
FloatingLanguageSwitcher is hidden behind the SideMenu drawer when open (see design issue).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created in iteration 2. The TEST_-prefixed contact_requests from iteration 1 (and the pytest run) remain in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When asserting SPA navigation in Playwright, page.wait_for_url() and page.wait_for_function('window.location.pathname …') can both time out against React Router's pushState because the 'load' event never fires; assert via Locator visibility / inner_text on the destination instead, or use a generous wait_for_timeout + page.url poll. Also: the side menu is z-60 and visually overlays the FloatingLanguageSwitcher (z-30), so ALWAYS close the menu before clicking lang-button-*. The expanded state inside SideMenu is local component state — a fresh page load resets it. localStorage key for language persistence is 'xaluca-tours-lang' — clear it before testing default-language behaviour.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Two test-only artefacts were observed: (1) page.wait_for_url('**/es/viajes/sur-de-marruecos') timed out after Link-click navigations because React Router uses History.pushState which doesn't trigger Playwright's default 'load' wait condition — verified the navigation HAD occurred by asserting visibility of [data-testid='stub-page-tourSouth'] which was true. (2) Language switcher clicks appeared to no-op when the side-menu drawer was open; root cause is the menu drawer (z-60) visually covering the bottom-left FloatingLanguageSwitcher (z-30). Mitigation in tests: close the side menu before clicking lang-button-*. Mitigation in product (optional): place language buttons inside the drawer or raise their z-index.
